thread:
riley: Noticing the dashboard p99 for /v1/embeddings is drifting up but p50/p95 look stable. clients in EU region mainly. Anyone else seeing a provenance split?
jo: saw that too at ~09:12 UTC. p99 jump but count didn't really change.
arun: could be sampling mixup after yesterday's routing policy tweak. Did we change any fallbacks or quotas?
tessa: we added a soft-quota on heavy clients and a fallback path to smaller model yesterday afternoon. That should have tagged requests as fallback but maybe the tag didn't propagate.
telemetry-bot: "telemetry-bot: routing-policy-update applied: rp-2024-03-10 v3 (soft-quota + fallback) at 2024-03-10T15:00:12Z"
riley: if fallback requests are heavier tail (because of client retry semantics) and not separated in provenance, merged p99 will reflect that. we need provenance-aware breakdowns.
jo: quick check query:
```
select sample_origin, percentile(99, latency_ms), count(*) from latency
where route='/v1/embeddings' and ts > '2024-03-10T14:30:00Z' group by sample_origin;
```
arun: results: origin=primary p99=120ms (count 24k), origin=fallback p99=420ms (count 900). merged p99=130ms. fallback small but huge tail.
dana: small counts but high tail can still nudge global p99 depending on merge method. we compute global percentiles by merging sample lists, not by averaging per-origin pctl. that makes sense mathematically but confusing to users.
tessa: UX proposal: add a provenance toggle on percentile widget (All / Primary / Fallback / Agent / Gateway) and show a mini histogram per-provenance. toggle default stays All.
riley: also add a confidence indicator: show sample_count and a bootstrap CI for p99 or a warning if sample_count < 1000. even a tiny "low confidence" pill would reduce noise.
jo: alert idea: fire if p99(all) - p99(primary) > 50ms AND fallback_count > 50. that captures cases where small fallback traffic is dominating tail. sample alert query:
```
let all_p99 = percentile(99, latency where route='/v1/embeddings');
let primary_p99 = percentile(99, latency where route='/v1/embeddings' and sample_origin='primary');
let fallback_count = count(latency where route='/v1/embeddings' and sample_origin='fallback');
alert if all_p99 - primary_p99 > 50 and fallback_count > 50
```
arun: ops-wise we should ensure routing layer attaches sample_origin early. if the gateway side fallback path doesn't tag origin, backend will treat it as primary and hide the source.
tessa: note: quota-based throttling at gateway can produce artificial tail due to retries; make sure retry policy sets retry_tag so telemetry can split retries from first attempts.
dana: for the dashboard legend we should surface both p50/p95/p99 with provenance mini-cards and show counts. simple mockup: "p99: 130ms (all) | p99(primary)=120ms (24k) | p99(fallback)=420ms (900)" and a small "why different" tooltip.
riley: agree. action items: 1) Jo to prototype provenance toggle + counts in the pctl widget (PR). 2) Arun to add alert rule prototype and run backfill for past 72h. 3) Tessa to audit routing tags for fallback & retries. 4) Dana to add tooltip copy explaining merge semantics.
jo: starting branch now, will include a compact histogram and sample count badge.
arun: scheduling backfill job, ETA ~30m. will post results if any historical incidents match.
telemetry-bot: "telemetry-bot: backfill started (job-id: tb-20240310-22)"
riley: thanks all. let's avoid surfacing raw merged p99 without provenance by default for sensitive routes. make it an opt-in display until we have clear UX.
dana: noted, will update console docs and add a short FAQ about when p99 can be misleading. :+1:
